recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It corrects the active datatype source without adding redundant narrative text or changing later FHIR-49899 semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 issue asking SampledData to add offsets, make interval optional, describe intervalUnit as applying to interval or offsets, and require one of interval or offsets but not both.
initial_application: Commit 6b6661326a added offsets and made interval optional in source/datatypes/sampleddata.xml, and later SampledData commits clarified offsets and exposed constraints in the datatype narrative. The current authoritative spreadsheet still retained period-only root comments, interval-only intervalUnit text, and an invariant label saying interval and offsets but not both.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists SampledData as an active normative datatype and maps old R4 SampledData.period to current SampledData.interval. The originating Zulip discussion and MnM minutes confirm variable sample timing and offset semantics were the driver. Later FHIR-49899 clarified offsets as relative to the logical start point and did not reverse the one-of interval/offsets rule.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/sampleddata.xml so the datatype comments require origin, dimensions, and either interval or offsets; changed intervalUnit's short and definition to cover interval or offsets; and corrected the invariant's English label to say interval or offsets while preserving the existing FHIRPath and XPath expressions.
source_changes: source/datatypes/sampleddata.xml: clarified the root SampledData comment, intervalUnit short/definition, and invariant English text to align with the offset/interval model.
